The '''Pair O'Dice''' was one of the three largest [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was located in the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]] hotel complex.<ref name="gg2-1st" /> The annual Cloud City Sabacc Tournament took place in the luxury Pair O'Dice casino of the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]] hotel.<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|20|BES 5-6|Bespin &ndash; Cloud City}}</ref>
